event_name: Date 15 April 2018 Time 15:18 2018 CHINESE GRAND PRIX 12 - 15 April 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 10 collided with car 28 in turn 14.
incident_time: Penalty (2 penalty points awarded, 2 points in total for the 12 month period)
offence: Involved in an incident as defined by Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards examined video evidence and the driver of car 10 caused a collision with car 28. The Stewards determined that the driver of car 10 was predominantly to blame for the collision. Nish Shetty Jose Abed Danny Sullivan Zheng Honghai
rules_referenced: Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting
title: 2018 Chinese Grand Prix 2018 Offence Car 10 Causing A Collision With Car 28 In T14 Doc 29
